policy.least_work_scope: optimizer routing only while work_delegation_gate is logically disabled; authoritative O revision 24 forbids applying revision-23 least-Work policy to primary O

receipt_policy.clean_exploration: write immutable role-local receipts under automation_control/receipts/<role>/ without reading EXECUTION_LEDGER.json, other receipt directories, or other-role receipt content
receipt_policy.downstream_roles: prefer immutable role-local receipts; shared aggregate is not a continuation authority
receipt_policy.aggregate: automation_optimizer is the only role allowed to read all role receipts and rewrite EXECUTION_LEDGER.json as a compact derived rollup
receipt_policy.reason: avoid multi-writer lost updates and prevent clean explorers from ingesting downstream/other-role semantics through observability files

policy.clean_own_state_resolution: For clean exploration, resolve semantic continuation from the role-local LATEST/STATE pointer first. If no valid pointer exists, select the newest source-qualified role-local checkpoint by repository chronology and read only the minimum needed predecessor chain. Do not use superseded/stale own state semantically merely because it is easy to find; if accidentally opened, quarantine it and report the exposure in the role-local receipt.
policy.candidate_identity: source-qualified stable identity; never join audits/comparisons by bare short candidate id alone
policy.decision_dimensions: novelty, evidence strength, and decision relevance remain separate fields even when produced by one comparator run
policy.bridge_freshness: bridge must pin feed reads to an observed note main SHA, recheck note main before BRIDGE_STATE mutation, refetch on head advance or revision regression, and never regress pending feed revision

primary_source_verifier.policy: verify high-value clean claims against primary sources with exact scope and no worker steering; select from current source-qualified candidates; after urgent feed candidates, rotate across under-audited namespaces instead of repeatedly concentrating on one worker; record what remains unverified separately from contradiction

o_novelty_comparator.policy: single O read-only pass produces TWO SEPARATE dimensions for the exact same current source-qualified candidate set: novelty/status (known/evaluated/partially tested/uncovered) and decision relevance (mechanism fit, expected information value, implementation/evaluation tractability, overlap with current O mechanisms, active uncertainty resolved, relevance class+rationale+uncertainty). Never use novelty as a proxy for relevance, never collapse into one score, never write worker feedback, never modify O. Relevance output must carry exact clean source blobs and O snapshot so integrator can reject stale joins.

evidence_comparator.policy: evidence strength from current clean candidates plus source-matched primary/reproducibility corrections: primary quality, quantitative result, matched baseline, ablation, reproducibility and exact scope; never write judgments to exploration; never attach audits by bare short id

integrator.policy: canonicalize/dedupe by source-qualified identity; preserve contradictions/scope/provenance/uncertainty; require current novelty, current evidence, and current decision relevance covering the exact same latest source blobs before admission; stale relevance must not be inferred from novelty/evidence; compact O_FEED; sanitized self-local feedback only

bridge.policy: bridge only clean O_FEED at safe O boundary; no extra Work solely for polling; no individual item spam; preserve exact revision/digest/blob acknowledgement; a fresh O owner suppresses recovery or duplicate writing; do not import the separate work_delegation_gate policy into primary O. Freshness handshake: read note latest main SHA first and fetch O_FEED at that exact SHA; before writing BRIDGE_STATE, re-read note latest main and refetch O_FEED if main advanced, if the observed feed revision regresses below the prior bridge pending revision, or if a newer integrator/feed receipt is visible. Never regress tracked feed revision. Prefer the newest verified feed revision/digest/blob and record any stale-read incident explicitly.

work_delegation_gate.logical_disable_reason: Two consecutive control-revision-3 runs found no gate-owned work; authoritative O revision 24 forbids exporting this policy into primary O, leaving no current execution source. Disable logically to remove wasted work and request physical scheduler disable to free a slot; retain rollback metadata and re-enable only if a concrete separate gate-owned queue/source is introduced.
work_delegation_gate.policy: LOGICALLY DISABLED. This least-Work policy belongs to a separate automation only and must never be appended/reasserted into primary O. If later re-enabled because a concrete gate-owned queue/source exists, optimize/reroute only that separate work toward ordinary reasoning, connected tools/APIs, automations, or repository/GitHub actions before Work; read O only for collision/safety checks.

automation_optimizer.policy: optimize repository-defined managed configuration from actual execution evidence; read all receipts; be sole aggregate-ledger reconciler; never self-disable; distinguish repository logical enable from physical scheduler state; respect authoritative targeting boundaries and never apply the separate work_delegation_gate least-Work policy to primary O; request physical scheduler changes explicitly when repository evidence shows a logically disabled role is wasting a scarce active slot.
